docs.summary: Copies GameObject trees and other values in memory by writing them out and reading them back. A reference to something inside the copy lands on its counterpart, and a reference to any other engine object is shared with the original.

docs.summary: Copies several roots as one, so a reference from one root to another lands on that root's copy.

members.signature: public static void CopyTo(GameObject source, GameObject target, CopyMap? map = null)

docs.summary: Copies a GameObject tree onto an existing one. Objects the map pairs, then components and children of the same type in the same place, are filled in place so references to them stay valid. What the target has beyond the source is kept, what it lacks is added, and its objects keep their own identifiers.
